narrative:
The FY2027 workforce plan carries about 18.0K FTE and GBP 780M of people cost, up 4.1% year on year. Clinical roles make up 61% of FTE, and Care Services alone accounts for GBP 231M of people cost because care homes run at a 55% people-cost ratio.

Two pressures pull in opposite directions. Dental needs more associate dentists and hygienists to serve growing private membership, while Care Services and Cromwell Hospital have clear savings from agency conversion and theatre scheduling.

The Workforce Planner reads staffing ratios, rostering and vacancy data in Snowflake, so every proposal stays inside CQC staffing constraints. Agency spend share is 11.8% today against a 9% target.

signals.title: Care Home Agency Staffing at 14% of Direct Cost
signals.excerpt: Agency nursing remains above the 9% target, concentrated in the Midlands & East cluster, while occupancy holds at 89%.

signals.title: NHS Elective Waiting List Above 7 Million
signals.excerpt: Referral-to-treatment waiting times continue to drive self-pay and PMI demand for diagnostics, orthopaedics and cataract procedures.
